dedupe_keys.name: r avaflow v4 mass flow model

description: r.avaflow v4 simulates landslides and interacting mass flows using one-phase or multi-phase representations. Martin Mergili, Shiva P. Pudasaini and contributors provide the C code, an online parameter guide and example simulations. Users supply terrain, release heights or hydrographs and material parameters for a configured site and raster resolution. Outputs include flow heights, velocities and derived impact indicators that can support infrastructure exposure analysis. The source header declares GPL-2.0-or-later and the code is free. Linux use integrates with GRASS GIS; a Windows variant uses essentially the same C solver. The paper archive additionally supplies study data and scripts under CC-BY-4.0. A limitation is version sensitivity: that archive contains revision 6, while the own guide recommends revision 7 after a GRASS compatibility fix. Terrain quality and release-surface definitions also affect results. The archive omits a copyrighted Köfels orthophoto. No directly related catalogue record was found, and no executable, archive or simulation was downloaded or run.
inputs: Elevation and release-height rasters or an input hydrograph
licence: GPL-2.0-or-later (source header); accompanying study archive CC-BY-4.0
